en.app.agent_error_desc: mouser-agent.exe did not start or is not answering. Check that it sits next to mouser-gui.exe.
en.haptic.ring_hover_desc: Pulse when the pointer moves over a different ring slot.
en.haptic.force_desc: Adjust how hard you need to press the gesture button to activate it.
en.haptic.force_warning: A lighter setting may cause accidental activations during normal use.
en.mouse.profile_shift_wheel: Shift + wheel scrolls sideways in this profile
en.ring.scope_global_desc: One set of ring actions is used in every application.
en.ring.scope_perapp_desc: Each app profile can have its own ring actions. Pick the profile to edit.
en.scroll.shift_wheel_desc: Turn off for apps such as Microsoft Project that give Shift + wheel their own meaning.
en.scroll.debug_mode_desc: Show the agent log panel on the Mouse page.
en.key_capture.reserved_sas: Windows reserves Ctrl+Alt+Delete; applications cannot send or capture it. Choose another shortcut.
en.key_capture.waiting: Waiting for the agent to capture keys...
en.toast.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard
en.dialog.diag_folder: Choose where to save the diagnostics folder
en.scroll.diagnostics_desc: Write a folder with logs, settings and device details for a bug report. Paths and user names are removed; nothing is uploaded.
en.problem.corrupt: The settings file is damaged. Mouser is running with default settings and has not overwritten the file.
en.problem.newer_version: The settings file comes from a newer Mouser. It is left untouched and defaults are used for now.
en.problem.unreadable: The settings file cannot be read. Mouser is running with default settings.
en.about.credits: Based on Mouser by Tom Badash, MIT licence. Device artwork from the Mouser project.
en.about.start_minimized: Start minimized does not apply: the background agent never opens a window at start. Open settings from its tray icon.
